================================================================================
cpath bare slices preserve patterns and expression ranges
================================================================================
class C {
  bool M(int[] a) => a is [.., var last];
  bool N(int[] a) => a is [1, ..];
  bool P(int[] a) => a is [.. var rest, 1];
  int[] R(int[] a) => a[1..];
  int[] S(int[] a) => [.. a, 1];
}

================================================================================
cpath file-based app directives retain following code
================================================================================
#!/usr/bin/env dotnet
#:project ../Shared/Shared.csproj
#:property TargetFramework=net10.0
int F(bool b) { if (b) return 1; return 0; }

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (shebang_directive)
  (file_based_directive)
  (file_based_directive)
  (global_statement
    (local_function_statement
      (predefined_type)
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter
          (predefined_type)
          (identifier)))
      (block
        (if_statement
          (identifier)
          (return_statement
            (integer_literal)))
        (return_statement
          (integer_literal))))))
